text: Under way in the season opener between DeepSeek and Muse Spark.
Spark calls for the loose ball.
Muse breaks clean through the middle, utterly unopposed with open green ahead.
Spark turns it home from point-blank range! Muse Spark lead one nil!
DeepSeek Rovers are immediately pinned back deep in their own territory as Muse Spark maintain a relentless early press.
Spark drives straight down the flank.
Spark finishes it off from close range for a second. DeepSeek Rovers find themselves two down.
Inches wide of the target.
Spark charges through the middle again.
Muse taps it in at the mouth, making it three nil.
Muse shouts confirmation after putting that one away.
A slight loss of balance in midfield sees Spark hit the deck, though the recovery routine is already whirring into motion.
Another effort drifts just wide.
Spark finds the net once more from point-blank range. That is four without reply now for Muse Spark.
Muse gets behind the defence again.
Muse marches right to the goalmouth.
Muse bundles it over the line to make it five nil. DeepSeek Rovers simply cannot stem the flow.
Spark drives straight through the centre once more.
Spark strikes again from three metres out. It is six nil now, turning into a proper rout.
Muse makes it seven nil from right on the line. Complete dominance here in the opening round.
A loose rebound skids past the target in the defensive third, offering a fleeting reprieve.
Just shaving the post from three metres out as Muse Spark press on.
Muse converts from point-blank range, taking the tally to eight.
DeepSeek have spent the last sixteen seconds pinned against their own wall, struggling to find any route out of their half.
Spark signals control against the wall.
Muse carries the ball cleanly along the touchline, keeping the play moving forward without much resistance.
Spark slips through on the left channel with nobody in pursuit.
Spark rolls it in from point-blank range for nine nil.
Muse calls out about peeling away from the boundary wall to reset position.
Spark hits double figures, nudging it home to make it ten nil to Muse Spark.
Muse adds another from two metres out. Eleven nil now, an unrelenting display.
Muse strokes it home once again. Twelve nil on the board with time ticking down in this first period.
Just skimming past the upright.
Muse immediately makes up for the miss, slotting in from two metres out for thirteen nil.
Thirteen nil at the break.
Spark carries it along the left flank as the buzzer sounds for the interval.
Abyss goes down following Muse's challenge.
Spark is through on goal.
Spark steps into the final third.
Spark converts cleanly from two metres out. Fourteen nil to Muse Spark.
A rare break back goes begging as the ball strays wide of the mark.
Spark signals their intent to help clear the magenta ball away from the danger area.
Muse Spark maintaining sustained pressure in the attacking third.
A snapshot from two metres drifts just past the frame.
Muse calls to the teammate about working the ball free off the perimeter wall.
Muse taps it in from point-blank range. That makes it fifteen nil.
Spark carries right into the box.
Spark adds another from close range. Sixteen nil, a comprehensive display from Muse Spark.
DeepSeek manage a strike from deep, but it trickles harmlessly wide of the target.
Muse shouts about prising the ball free.
Muse Spark have kept DeepSeek pinned back for nearly half a minute.
Signal suddenly finds a clear path forward from deep, though there is plenty of ground left to cover.
Spark calls out to indicate the ball is being steered clear along the right touchline.
Both sides make their calls on the fly with every single touch, but Muse Spark have looked miles sharper today.
The corner ram panel springs to life, firing the magenta ball back into open territory.
Muse takes a tumble in the final third, quickly initiating the self-righting sequence.
Another slip for Muse, hitting the deck once more.
Muse goes down for a third time in quick succession, motors working to get upright as the seconds tick down.
Full time, and it finishes DeepSeek Rovers nil, Muse Spark sixteen, a dominant opening performance.
